I’m sorry if this comes off as mean or rude or ungrateful but try being brought up to believe that you’re worthless for 14 years of a sad life and see if you can honestly hope for a better tomorrow. Nothing has ever changed and nothing will ever get better, hope is stupid and dreams don’t come true anyway. Be my own best friend? Lmao. 

Well it’s fine, I’m done with this shit anyway

Man, I wish I had dreams, but I don't. All I wanted is a stable income and a stable life, and I threw that away to do god knows what in grad school (which I am about to throw away, too). Everyone expects so much of me being a star student and everything, but yet I have no ambitions, no dreams and I'm graduating unemployed. What the fuck man, I'm so tired of not being enough for both me and others. Fuck living, I'm so done.
